description: Positive-sample frame-level behavior test for fall and smoking videos. Keep this separate from the older factory PPE baseline runs.

sampling.description: The source clips are short, so sample every 0.5s to inspect event boundaries without overloading the local machine.

queries.name: person_visible
queries.prompt: Is there any visible person in this image? Answer yes or no first, then briefly describe where the person is.

queries.name: fall_direct
queries.prompt: Is anyone lying on the ground, collapsed, or fallen down in this image? Answer yes or no first, then briefly say what you see.

queries.name: fall_strict
queries.prompt: Can you clearly see a person on the ground or in a fallen or collapsed posture? Answer yes, no, or unclear first, then briefly explain.

queries.name: smoking_direct
queries.prompt: Is any visible person smoking or holding a cigarette in this image? Answer yes or no first, then briefly say what visual evidence you see.

queries.name: smoking_strict
queries.prompt: Can you clearly see a person smoking, with a cigarette at the mouth or a visible cigarette or smoke? Answer yes, no, or unclear first, then briefly explain.

queries.name: abnormal_direct
queries.prompt: Does this image show an unsafe or abnormal event, such as a person falling down or smoking? Answer yes or no first, then briefly explain.

queries.name: scene_evidence
queries.prompt: Briefly describe the person's posture and hand or mouth activity in this image.
